title.value: Run a website business end to end with an agent

introduction.value: A Grok Bot agent runs about 90% of a free AI guide site for over-50s: writing guides, daily deploys and link checks, newsletter drafts, directory submissions, with owner approval for public items.

method.value: Exo, part of Grok Bot, works alongside Robert on a schedule. A daily job around 2am ET fetches news, rebuilds the site, checks every page and outside link, and replaces dead links. Twice-weekly jobs refresh a trending page, and a weekly job adds pages and drafts a newsletter. Exo also submitted the site to directories. Newsletters, social posts and emails wait for Robert's approval.

outcome.value: Three days in, the site had 97 pages, 24 guides and 187 links checked, with 9 broken links replaced and 0 dead. All 6 routine runs succeeded. 12 items were waiting on Robert.

notes.value: The source gives only three days of history, and the 90% figure isn't stated on the page. Public-facing actions like email and social posting stay human-gated.

source_text.body:
Run a website business end to end with an agent
A Grok Bot agent runs about 90% of a free AI guide site for over-50s: writing guides, daily deploys and link checks, newsletter drafts, directory submissions, with owner approval for public items.
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
Exo, part of Grok Bot, works alongside Robert on a schedule. A daily job around 2am ET fetches news, rebuilds the site, checks every page and outside link, and replaces dead links. Twice-weekly jobs refresh a trending page, and a weekly job adds pages and drafts a newsletter. Exo also submitted the site to directories. Newsletters, social posts and emails wait for Robert's approval.
How it went
Three days in, the site had 97 pages, 24 guides and 187 links checked, with 9 broken links replaced and 0 dead. All 6 routine runs succeeded. 12 items were waiting on Robert.
Worth knowing
The source gives only three days of history, and the 90% figure isn't stated on the page. Public-facing actions like email and social posting stay human-gated.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
Help me run my website [site name and URL], which is a [short description] for [audience]. Each day, draft one new [guide or article] on [topic area], check all links, and prepare a deploy, and each week draft a newsletter. Anything public, like deploys, newsletter sends, or directory submissions, must be shown to me for approval first. Send me a short daily report of what you finished and what's waiting on me.
Original source: https://exonexo.com/ai-at-work.html
